item.title: CDO Confessions – Part 3: Centralized or Federated? Where Governance Games End CDO Careers
item.description: In my search for a metaphor that could make sense of the federated chaos that defines digital governance today, I turned first to my favorite heist and action films, stories where teams of specialists come together for impossible missions.
